title: asplenium dielerectum
intro: Asplenium dielerectum, commonly known as the Vairumati fern, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Asplenium dielerectum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce fever, treat digestive issues, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory problems, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides.
